name: Konno Tamami
source:
Tamami has a quiet and shy personality. She held a record in swimming during junior high school. She is the elder sister of  [url=http://vndb.org/c1268]Konno Tamao[/url]. Tamami is the manager of the basketball club and is friendly with Suzuka. If the main character dates Suzuka she becomes a rival.

[edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tokimeki_Memorial_Girl%27s_Side]Wikipedia[/url]]
